authorship.model_snapshot: current Codex task model; exact deployment id not exposed to task

inspiration.relationship: Transforms f021 construction into snapped coordinate-addressed graph members and exact integer capacities; f023 place-then-simulate into a recoverable structural load-test audit; f026 stability constraints into explicit redundant paths and complete triangle braces; f031 material attachment affordances into shape-coded compression, tension, and buckling sockets; and f040 prepare-then-endure into several deterministic load positions evaluated after construction.
inspiration.structural_difference: The player directly clicks drawn spans between architectural joints to install or reclaim finite timber, cable, and steel members. Exact undirected max-flow, typed member validity, complete gusset triangles, buckling flags, and multiple static stress cases determine success; there is no continuous physics, freehand drawing, avatar, autonomous walker, selector/pump loop, combat, timing pressure, or hidden numeric label.

mechanics.novelty_claim: A direct spatial bridge builder turns material silhouettes and architectural geometry into an exact graph proof: a successful pavilion must simultaneously satisfy capacity, edge redundancy, typed tension/compression affordances, non-buckling long members, complete triangular bays, and several visible load positions while every placed member remains individually reclaimable.

failure_modes: builds one connected route when two or three edge-disjoint load paths are required
spends double-capacity steel where a timber member would preserve scarce stock
places straight timber on a dotted sagging tension span
places cable on a double-ticked compression span
uses timber across a red-kinked long member and overlooks deterministic buckling
leaves one side of a required triangular gusset open
supports the first lantern position but not the later load or cross-wind case
forgets that clicking an occupied member reclaims its exact material
load-tests before all visible hanging load bundles and gusset demands are supported

interface.coordinate_action: Action 6 installs or reclaims the nearest candidate member at the supplied x,y coordinate; actions 3 and 4 cycle material, and action 5 performs the load test.

progression.new_demand: Place two timber members directly on their drawn spans, observe bolt-and-grain settlement, and support one hanging load.
Construct three independent warm-timber routes so a tripled load crosses without sharing a capacity edge.
Introduce cyan steel and combine one double-capacity route with one timber route to carry the same tripled load using fewer members.
Complete two visibly gusseted triangular bays; connectivity and load capacity alone no longer certify the frame.
Assign timber to compression, sagging cable to tension, and steel to the red-kinked long member that would buckle in timber.
Build a typed two-trunk frame that independently supports two lantern positions and a lateral cross-wind load case.
Compose two full triangular bays, two edge-disjoint crossing paths, and typed compression and tension stock in one pavilion.
Coordinate all three materials, a steel anti-buckling chord, paired gussets, doubled end loads, two moving-load positions, and a tripled lower-deck stress case.

visual_identity.silhouette_grammar: Round riveted joints, arched anchor crowns, double-ticked compression guides, sagging dotted tension guides, red buckling kinks, grain-striped timber, bead-ended cables, riveted steel chords, diamond gussets, pennant loads, and scalloped canopy cloth replace raw square bars.
visual_identity.spatial_grammar: A bright warm fixed-camera architectural elevation spans a pale sunrise above masonry footings; the direct construction graph dominates the canvas, loose shaped material samples sit along the canopy edge, and paired inspection seals remain embedded in the lower stonework.
visual_identity.motion_grammar: Members grow bolt-first along the clicked span, removed pieces retract into ghost grain or cable, material samples travel across the tool rack, load tests sweep stress through every valid member, pennants settle at supported joints, success raises a festival of concentric arches, and failure visibly slumps the built geometry.
visual_identity.hud_grammar: Orange diamond fasteners show exact remaining construction actions, miniature material silhouettes with matching leftover beads expose stock without digits, intact green circular seals versus crossed red seals expose recovery, and every load unit is a separate hanging diamond bundle.
